# iru_custom_script (Data Source)

Reads one exact Custom Script Library Item through GET only. Reports current script/remediation bytes, execution settings and optional Self Service metadata without defaults or normalization. Missing/null documented core fields are errors; optional missing/null metadata remains null. Does not upload, assign, activate or execute scripts. The single-object endpoint is not paginated.

Reads exact script/remediation bytes, execution settings and reported Self Service
metadata for one Library Item UUID. Script fields are sensitive and remain in
state. Hidden category/recommendation observations are retained; they need not
satisfy the managed resource's write-side Self Service constraints.

See [configuration lookup behavior](../guides/configuration-lookups.md) for
selection, errors, nulls and sensitive state handling.

## Example Usage


```terraform
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

# Synthetic UUID: replace with an existing Custom Script Library Item UUID.
data "iru_custom_script" "selected" {
  library_item_id = "aaaaaaaa-bbbb-4ccc-8ddd-000000000092"
}

output "script_name" {
  value = data.iru_custom_script.selected.name
}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `library_item_id` (String) Exact existing Custom Script Library Item UUID. Names and partial IDs are not accepted.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether Iru reports the Library Item as active. Reading never activates it.
- `execution_frequency` (String) Observed once, every_15_min, every_day or no_enforcement setting; reading never schedules execution.
- `id` (String) Canonical Custom Script UUID.
- `name` (String) Current Library Item display name.
- `remediation_script` (String, Sensitive) Exact remediation script bytes reported by Iru. A returned empty string remains empty. Sensitive in displays but stored in Terraform state.
- `restart` (Boolean) Whether Iru reports restart enabled. Reading never restarts a device.
- `script` (String, Sensitive) Exact script bytes reported by Iru, including meaningful whitespace. Sensitive in displays but stored in Terraform state.
- `self_service_category_id` (String) Reported Self Service category UUID, or null when omitted/null. Preserved even when visibility is false.
- `self_service_recommended` (Boolean) Reported recommendation flag, or null when omitted/null, distinct from false. Preserved even when visibility is false.
- `show_in_self_service` (Boolean) Observed Self Service visibility; null when omitted/null in the response, distinct from false.
